score.title: Score from your wrist.
score.body: Add a point with a tap on Apple Watch or iPhone and keep your head in the game. Your team names and colours stay with the result.
bullets: Works on iPhone and iPad too

mixed.title: Always know the next set.
mixed.body: Pick ABBA or OWWO/WOOW and Huck advances the active set as the score changes. No more arguing about who is on next.

media.alt: Huck scoreboard with the active mixed set highlighted

stats.title: Your goals. Your assists.
stats.body: Tap Goal, Assist or Skip right after a point, from your wrist. Look back at your contribution once the game is done.
bullets: Quick, one-tap buttons on Apple Watch
Personal stats saved with each game

media.alt: Goal and Assist buttons on Apple Watch

workout.title: Record the effort, too.
workout.body: Huck records a workout on Apple Watch while you keep score, then shows duration, distance, active energy and heart rate alongside the game when available.
bullets: Duration, distance, active energy, heart rate
Optional: needs Apple Watch and Health permission
Huck works without it if you'd rather skip

media.alt: Huck workout screen on Apple Watch

teams.title: Your teams, ready to play.
teams.body: Set team names, colours and your set rotation before the first pull. They follow the game into your summary and history.

media.alt: Huck game setup with teams and set tracking

results.title: Save the result. Share the win.
results.body: Every game ends with a summary you can look back on, and a result card to share with the team.

media.alt: Huck game summary with final score and share options
